name: SecAgent Chinese Mobile GUI Navigation Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating mobile GUI agents on Chinese smartphone tasks, featuring multi-choice action annotations across 44 applications. It measures the ability of models to navigate and interact with mobile interfaces efficiently using semantic context.
reputation: This benchmark is a recent Chinese mobile GUI navigation test and is still emerging, with adoption likely concentrated in mobile agent research rather than broad community use.
notes: Focuses on Chinese language and mobile GUI navigation with semantic context summarization to reduce computational cost.
